blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government will offer at least P30 billion in retail treasury bonds (RTBs) to small investors starting next week, with a 2.5-year maturity due in 2029. In a notice of offering posted Wednesday night, the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) said its 32nd RTB issuance will be offered from Sept. 29 to Oct. 7, with the issue date set for Oct. 12. READ: Philippine Treasury scales back upcoming retail T-bond sale The latest RTB sale marks the government’s 25th year of tapping retail investors.
